usage: 老鷹 (lou5 jing1) is a noun referring to a large bird of prey known for its sharp eyesight and powerful flying abilities.
You can use 老鷹 when talking about wildlife, nature, or birds in general.
In sentences, 老鷹 can be the subject: 老鷹飛得好快 (The eagle flies very fast).
It can also be the object: 我睇到一隻老鷹 (I saw an eagle).
老鷹 rarely functions as a metaphor in casual conversations, but it can symbolize sharp vision or strength.
